llm.summary: The skill is a task-tracking loop, but it gives the agent broad autonomous execution instructions and requires Telegram progress messages that can expose task details outside the workspace.

dimensions.detail: The task-loop purpose is coherent, but the skill applies it broadly to autonomous user tasks and instructs the agent to write code, run commands, create files, fetch data, and keep going with minimal clarification.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger covering any autonomous task is overbroad, and the 'never stop' protocol materially reduces user control except after repeated failure or missing critical information.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only markdown instructions and small metadata; there are no executable install scripts, package dependencies, or VirusTotal detections supplied.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Creating and updating a local progress file is proportionate for a task loop, but mandatory Telegram updates transmit task names, progress, errors, and file paths to an external service without a clear opt-in gate.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill uses a persistent workspace memory file during execution and deletes it on completion; this is disclosed, but deletion can remove an audit trail the user may want to inspect.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use this only when you explicitly want an agent to run a multi-step task with limited interruptions, and avoid it for sensitive work unless Telegram notifications are disabled or you are comfortable sending task details, errors, and file paths to that channel.
llm.findings:
[SDI-2] unexpected: Progress updates fit the skill's purpose, but requiring Telegram as the update channel creates external data sharing beyond a local task-tracking loop.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad autonomous-task trigger and repeated 'do not stop' language are under-scoped for a reusable skill and can affect unrelated sensitive tasks.
[SQP-2] expected: Creating and updating /workspace/memory/ralph-loop.md is expected for this skill, though users should know it will be deleted at completion.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Mandatory Telegram start, progress, pause, and completion messages are disclosed in the body, but they are not clearly opt-in and may reveal sensitive task context.
